answer: Agents register a TPM/SGX enclave identity and submit a zero-knowledge attestation of sealed code and a fresh nonce to the raven state tree; the onyx hash anchor commits each identity, while the crystal consensus contract verifies quotes and enforces a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2).
